name_en: Koshimeshi — winter-harvested rock nori worked into New Year's Eve rice
summary_ja: ちりめんじゃこや刻んだ魚を炊き込んだご飯に、冬の海に浸かって採る岩のり「めのり」を仕上げに混ぜる大月町の年越し料理。「越しめし」から転じたとされ、年越しそばの代わりに定着していたという。
summary_en: Rice cooked with dried baby sardines or minced fish is finished with rock nori called menori, gathered by wading chest-deep into the winter sea — a New Year's Eve dish from Otsuki Town. The name is said to derive from "koshimeshi," rice for seeing out the year, and it long stood in for the more common year-end soba noodles.
source_title: こうし飯 高知県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
